Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each

Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/SER A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Special Conditions of GeM bid for procurement of 02 Nos. of Anaesthesia Work Station with Multipara Monitor and AGM etc. 1. Warranty Clause:- I. The tenderer shall offer full replacement warranty on the complete system comprisi ng of all hardware and software, both imported and indigenous, for 24 months from the dat e of commissioning at Central Hospital/GRC. II. During the warranty period, maximum allowable down time shall be up to 18 days pe r annum and response time shall be within 02 days from the time of intimation. In case s ervice engineer of the contractor fails to attend the system within 2 days from the intimati on of communication of failure, a penalty of Rs 2200/- per day for each machine (unit) for additional days taken to attend by service engineer shall be levied. Further, a penalty of Rs 2200/- per day shall be levied for down time beyond 18 days in a year. III. Maximum penalty to be levied on account of warranty failure will be 5% (Five p ercent) of the contract value of the machine/system calculated during whole of war rantee period and after that if there is any delay on the part of supplier, purchaser

shall be entitled for encashment of WG Bonds. In such cases the bad performance o f firm during the warranty period, the same should be given due regard in deciding f uture orders on the firm and when evidence to the contrary is not available, the fir m’s offer may be even rejected. 2. MAJOR/MINOR PARAMETERS: Tenderers may please note the following- Major Parameters (Critical) and Minor Parameters (Non-Critical) are mentioned in the specification. No deviation against major parameters shall be acceptable.Minor Parameters where deviations, if any, may be considered on technical merit. 3. Scope of Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC): (i) The CAMC will be operated by the consignee. CAMC will be optional to the Railways. Rail ways may at its own discretion, either enter into Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Cont ract (CAMC) for the equipment with the firm for the CAMC period as specified after complet ion of warranty period or invite fresh tender for CAMC based on the prevalent market trend . In the event that the Railways enters into a Comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (CAMC) with the firm as per this tender, the terms and conditions shall be governed as me ntioned herewith in special conditions of tender & General Conditions of Tenders for Suppl y Contract; and the rates quoted by the firm in this tender shall remain binding on the firm. (ii) Annual Maintenance Contract for a period will be 05 (Five) years beyond the war ranty period. The scope of CAMC will include preventive and breakdown maintenance. CA MC charges will include all costs of personnel, spares etc. except the cost of consumables required for day-to-day operation. (iii) Repair of defective parts/ components/ assemblies required in CAMC [preventive m aintenance and breakdown maintenance as and when required] shall be done by th e firm. However, in case repair needs to be done at firm’s repair center, then the sa me can be allowed as exceptional case only when the firm submits Bank Guarantee of equal amount of the cost of the parts/ components/ assemblies as decided by the consignee to safeguard the interest of Railways. All incidental charges and procedur al work involved in sending and returning the parts/components/assemblies shall be borne and done by the firm. Consignee will keep and maintain all relevant documen tation properly and safely. (iv) During CAMC period, maximum allowable down time shall be up to 18 days per annum an d response time shall be up to 02 days from the time of intimation. In case service engin eer of the contractor fails to attend the system within 02 days from the intimation of comm unication of failure, a penalty of Rs. 2200/- per day for each machine (unit) for additional d ays taken to attend by service engineer shall be levied. Further, a penalty of Rs. 2200/- p er day shall be levied for for each machine (unit) down time beyond 18 days in a year. Total annual penalty shall not exceed 5% of the CAMC charges of that year. CAMC Paymen t terms should be linked to these performance parameters. Consignee may enter into CAM C contract for 05 years after expiry of warranty period. (v) Payment Terms for CAMC: Payment of CAMC as mentioned in tender schedule will be made yearly basis subject s atisfactory performance of the system. The firm will submit Bank Guarantee for the 5% of total contract value of CAMC for 05

years, valid for a period of eight years plus 60 days. This Bank Guarantee is required t o be submitted one month before completion of warranty period. The performance BG su bmitted for warranty period will not be released till BG for CAMC is submitted. If supplier fails t o submit the CAMC BG within the validity of warranty BG, the Warranty BG will be forfeited by the Railways. 4. The manufacturer shall also ensure availability of all such required spare parts for at least 07 year s/Life of the system after commissioning. The manufacturer must provide to support the equipmen t with technical service and spare parts for at least 07 years from the date of commissioning. Note- Offers without CAMC charges will be summarily ignored because such offe rs cannot be compared with other offers in determining inter-se ranking as CAM C will be integral part of the contract. . 10.
